QUOTE: "If that is not defined, it is the stub `platform_calloc_uninit`, which always returns NULL (`platform.c:24-33, 44`). The same applies to free, where the stub does nothing. So an unconfigured dynamic build fails every allocation rather than silently using libc."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the uninitialised calloc stub returns NULL, the free stub does nothing, and that this fails rather than falling back to libc.
